title: Coarse-Graining Recursive Expert Computation: Continuation-Relative Interfaces and Failure Modes
abstract: arXiv:2610.14413v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computational coarse-graining aims to replace a sequence of updates with a cheaper module while preserving task performance. We present a continuation-relative evaluation framework that assesses replacements through the computation that follows them, using downstream task quality and total execution cost as joint criteria. The framework distinguishes boundary representations, summaries of skipped computation, executed operations, and downstream loss. It makes interfaces and permitted deployment information explicit, combines fine-path references with directly trained controls using the same shortened architecture, and accounts for selection overhead. An exact loss decomposition separates replacement effects at a fixed downstream action from effects of changing that action. A finite construction shows how retained information can reduce the stipulated cost of zero-error prediction under fixed information and controller restrictions. Exp

translated_title: 递归专家计算的粗粒化：延续相对接口与失效模式
translated_abstract: 计算粗粒化旨在用一个更廉价的模块替换一系列更新，同时保持任务性能。我们提出了一个延续相对的评估框架，通过替换之后所发生的计算来评估替换，并以下游任务质量和总执行成本作为联合标准。该框架区分了边界表示、被跳过计算的摘要、已执行的操作以及下游损失。它使接口和允许使用的部署信息明确化，将细路径参考与使用相同缩短架构的直接训练对照组相结合，并考虑了选择开销。一个精确的损失分解将固定下游动作下的替换效应与改变该动作所产生的效应分离开来。一个有限构造展示了在固定信息和控制器限制下，被保留的信息如何能够降低零误差预测的规定成本。
tldr: 提出一个延续相对的评估框架，通过下游任务质量与总执行成本的联合标准评估递归专家计算中的粗粒化模块替换，并利用精确损失分解区分固定下游动作下的替换效应与动作改变效应，从而揭示接口设计与失效模式。
en_tdlr: A continuation-relative evaluation framework assesses coarse-graining replacements in recursive expert computation using downstream task quality and total execution cost as joint criteria, with an exact loss decomposition separating replacement effects at fixed downstream actions from the effects of changing that action.
